questions.stem_text: What is the meaning of justiciability?

options.A: Justiciability refers to the limitation of a State to enforce a particular right
options.B: Justiciability refers to the ethical implications of a particular right
options.C: Justiciability refers to the just nature or cause of a particular right
options.D: Justiciability refers to the availability of legal remedies for a particular right
options.E: Justiciability refers to the obligation of a State to enforce a particular Right

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Justiciability refers to the limitation of a State to enforce a particular right

Which of the following quotations best describes the central thesis of difference
feminism?

options.A: 'Difference feminism argues that men and women are fundamentally the same.'
options.B: Men are unable to comprehend their differences from women.'
options.C: 'Men and women differ only in physical attributes, not in their thought processes.'
options.D: 'Men are more inclined towards justice, while women tend to focus on fairness.'
options.E: There are fundamental differences between individual women.'

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - 'Difference feminism argues that men and women are fundamentally the same.'

questions.stem_text: Lyotard's dictum 'I define postmodern as incredulity toward meta-narratives' means:

options.D: The concept of truth is objective and undeniable.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Universal values are meaningless.

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following purposes does the 'internal point of view' play in Hart's concept
of law?

options.A: It distinguishes social rules from mere group habits.
options.C: It illustrates the authority of the legislature.
options.D: It stresses the relationship between law and justice.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - It distinguishes social rules from mere group habits.
